images.alt_text: A replay-safety, time and shared-budget sieve routes eligible read-only inference to primary or approved secondary, converges on one accepted result and diverts uncertain actions to reconciliation.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: A read-only operation can use a qualified alternate provider only within replay, time and policy boundaries; ambiguous actions need reconciliation. Replay safety, deadline and shared budget are exposed in the eligibility sieve. Primary and eligible secondary converge to one result; uncertain actions branch to reconciliation and an ineligible route stops. Gradual failback is a policy brace rather than a result path. Two rejected candidates had an incorrect failback connector and control bypass; the third corrected them. All fourteen labels are readable in the exact saved PNG.

images.alt_text: An exploded chat base, decision and guardian adapters share KV context while a separate speech encoder produces transcription, with distinct decision and safety outputs and a workload-evaluation strip.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: A common chat base combines decision and guardian adapters with a colocated speech encoder; activated adapters can reuse the base KV cache. Exploded chat base, decision and guardian adapters share the exposed KV cache; the speech encoder supplies transcription separately. Cyan decision output originates at decision adapter, purple safety output at guardian. First draft misattached decision output; corrected second draft also removed simulated writing. All fourteen labels are correct and legible. Geometry is conceptual model composition, not physical GPU architecture.

images.alt_text: Five knowledge terraces connect capture, validation, organization, governance and delivery above a continuous provenance rail, with expert revalidation, scope, permissions and audit history visible.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: Reliable enterprise context requires a continuously maintained five-stage knowledge lifecycle, beyond storage and retrieval. The five terraced stages preserve source/owner provenance; validation includes trust comparison and expert revalidation, organization separates scope and governance exposes permissions/audit. First draft had prohibited avatar symbols, omitted Deliver and duplicate Provenance. The corrected version removes avatars, includes all fourteen unique labels and retains the revalidation loop. Small document glyphs denote records rather than readable prose.

images.alt_text: An opened risk-assessment report exposes scope, access, disclosure, redaction, pressure and funding constraints alongside methods and uncertainty; confidential material stays protected while public findings invite scrutiny.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: Readers need visible process constraints to interpret independent AI-risk findings; transparency supports scrutiny without certifying deployment safety. Fanned report leaves expose scope, access, disclosure terms, redactions, informal pressures and conflicts alongside methods and uncertainty. Confidential material is withheld from public scrutiny; findings are explicitly not certification. First draft added unauthorized headings and paragraph-like marks. Corrected second draft removes them and replaces a probability-like plot with unscaled conceptual uncertainty paths. All thirteen labels are readable.

images.alt_text: A compact active-context well receives short previews, recoverable summaries, selected skills and isolated research results while raw evidence and plain-file long-term memory remain recoverable across models.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: Five context-management mechanisms keep active context focused while preserving recoverable raw records and user-controlled persistent memory. Radial active context receives previews, recoverable summaries, selectively loaded skills and isolated-work results; raw evidence remains retrievable and plain-file long-term memory supports model portability. First draft included paragraph-like strokes and overly textured surfaces; second draft removes all faux writing and preserves fourteen labels. The five mechanisms are distinct and no raw subagent stream directly enters active context.

images.alt_text: Allow, Ask and Deny gates govern skill loading; a read-only release-note bench compares draft notes with merged PRs and returns a version proposal and copyable command before a separate human approval and closed publishing boundary.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: A portable release-note procedure drafts and compares outputs under explicit permissions; publishing remains behind human approval. Permission lattice separates Allow/Ask/Deny skill loading from a read-only evidence-comparison bench and a separate human publishing decision. The draft and PR specimens use conventional list/branch glyphs without pseudo-letters or invented text. First draft contained a hand icon and crossed the publication wall; corrected second draft removes both and keeps outputs before the closed boundary. All fifteen labels readable and correct.

set_review.differentiation_evidence: Actual saved PNGs and six-set contact sheet were inspected. The six visibly different compositions use a split-route eligibility cutaway; exploded checkpoint anatomy with shared cache; ascending knowledge terraces and provenance rail; transparent fanned assessment report; radial recoverable-context landscape; and permission lattice with evidence workbench and closed publishing wall. Teal/amber, indigo/cyan, forest/ochre, burgundy/slate, copper/turquoise and navy/gold balances differ. Their geometry is conceptual, never measured physical architecture. No more than two share a primary grammar.
